section: 13.5.2 Among the metropolitan cities, Delhi reported the highest number of Theft cases (19,206) with a property loss of Rs. 4985.3 lakhs, followed by Mumbai with 14,086 cases wherein property worth Rs. 6201.5 lakhs was stolen. The highest number of cases of Theft at ‘Highways’ (727) and at Railways (722) with a loss of property worth Rs. 260.5 lakhs and Rs.51.7 lakhs respectively were reported from Delhi.
